::: interests
*Profile.* Data scientist and social scientist. I work on public opinion and elections, public policy evaluation, and data on the Amazon, mostly in R and Python. I currently calibrate election polls in several countries at AtlasIntel, coordinate the quantitative analysis of a project on cooperatives and deforestation in Acre, and work on a systematic review of public security policies for Brazil's Ministry of Justice.
:::

# Experience

### [AtlasIntel](https://atlasintel.org/) [06/2025 -- Present]{.date}

*Data Scientist*

Calibration of election polls in several countries, design of probability-based face-to-face surveys, and the introduction of conjoint experiments.

### RESA project, UFAC, IESP-UERJ and IFAC [08/2025 -- Present]{.date}

*Coordinator of Quantitative Methods and Analysis*

I coordinate the quantitative analysis of a project on what agroextractive cooperatives change in household income and deforestation in Acre, selected in an Instituto Clima e Sociedade call supported by the Bezos Earth Fund. [[Platform]](https://mapa-do-desmatamento-acre.streamlit.app/) · [[Working site]](https://felipelamarca.com/Legal-Acre/)

### *Pensando o Direito* research grant, MJSP [07/2026 -- Present]{.date}

*Researcher*

Systematic review of the evidence on 12 public security policies for the Legal Amazon, with a report for the Ministry of Justice and Public Security.

### MAPE, DOXA and NECON laboratories, IESP-UERJ [04/2025 -- Present]{.date}

*Researcher*

I build and maintain `mape_municipios` (30 years and 451 variables on Brazilian municipalities) and its public interface, analyze the DOXA surveys, and work on NECON's roll-call databases.

### Independent consulting [07/2024 -- Present]{.date}

*Consultant in Data Science and Research*

Data tools to monitor the education programs of Fundação Roberto Marinho, Python and machine learning courses for the teams of the foundation and of Plataforma CIPÓ, and data tools for research on armed violence at GENI/UFF.

### [Instituto Rio21](https://rio21.org/) [04/2022 -- 06/2025]{.date}

*Data Scientist and Researcher*

Ran and analyzed surveys on public policy and urban security.

## Software

- **`mapa-da-ciencia`** (2026). A literature observatory built on local language models. [[Access link]](https://felipelamarca.com/mapa-da-ciencia/)
- **DHBB-Parentescos** (2026). The kinship network of Brazilian politics, extracted with language models from the entries of the DHBB. [[Access link]](https://felipelamarca.com/DHBB-Parentescos/)
- **`mape_municipios_dashboard`** (2025). With Fernando Meireles. A dashboard over the `mape_municipios` database, built for MAPE. [[Access link]](https://mape-municipios-dashboard.streamlit.app/)
- **RelicárIA** (2025). With Danielle Sanches de Almeida. AI and data analysis to extract and visualize information from historical documents, awarded at the DH Awards 2025. [[Access link]](https://relicariastudio.com.br/)
